resources.string: The sound effect is drawn again in its translation, in the style of the original

A chapter opens in the original and costs nothing. To translate it, tap ⋯ → Translate the chapter in the reader (or the globe button below), or select chapters in the list and tap Translate. The chapter is translated whole in the background, also when you leave the reader, and then opens translated; ⋯ switches between the original and the translation. Each page is one request to the AI provider: it finds the text and translates it. A vision model is needed (e.g. Gemini Flash, GPT-4o-class, Claude). Translated pages are kept, so re-reading costs nothing.
Pages: %1$d, %2$s. Kept for good: a page translated once is only drawn again, even offline. Tap to delete them all
Delete all saved translations? Pages will be translated by the model again when read, and that uses tokens again.
To go on, open the chapter or select chapters and tap Translate again: pages already done are kept.
The model translates it anew, and that uses tokens again. The saved translation is replaced.
When the open chapter is done, the next one is translated in the background: no wait when you turn to it. Uses tokens on a chapter you may not open
